message:
fix(api)!: reconcile owned public defaults and migration proofs

Record the omitted-selection change and source-pinned default validation.
Preserve the original default-change commits and their release-marker gaps.

BREAKING CHANGE: DateRangeSelector and DateRangePicker now default rangeClickBehavior to
"adjust-nearest"; pass rangeClickBehavior="adjust-end" to retain the previous completed-range
click behavior. Multi-month Calendar, DateRangeSelector and DateRangePicker now default
calendarNavigation to "independent"; pass calendarNavigation="linked" to keep consecutive views
moving together.
safety: Only configured analyzer and installed pure next-version helper invoked. Semantic-release entry point and verify/prepare/publish/success/fail hooks never invoked; no credentials supplied, git/network writes, version edits or candidate selection.
